title: truss transcript extract, version 1
description: <truss dir>/retro/extract.json: what retro/extract.ts read mechanically from one session's transcripts (R-24). factory.ts finish and retro/cli.ts extract overwrite it whole. The same transcripts and catalog give the same bytes: no wall-clock time, files in code-point order of path, items in file order then line order. It holds short quotes, so it stays inside .git with the truss dir and is never committed (R-32); it is kept until the truss dir is removed, so no later step needs the transcripts (R-35). See adr/0012-self-improving-retro.md, Decision 2.

v.description: File format version. A reader treats a file with any other v as absent.

session.description: The session id: the session transcript dir's base name.

files.description: Every transcript file read, in code-point order of path. path is relative to the project's transcript dir (the session dir's parent), with forward slashes: <session>.jsonl, <session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl, <session>/subagents/workflows/<run id>/journal.jsonl and <session>/subagents/workflows/<run id>/agent-<id>.jsonl. lines is the file's line count, so evidence can be checked after the file is gone.

items.description: One entry per thing found, in file order, then line order, then the order of the kinds in this schema's $defs.item.

catalogHits.description: Lines of tool_result text and journal result text that hit a catalog entry: the line holds the entry's anchor and matches one of its patterns. At most one hit per entry per record. A tool_result of a quiet call gives no hits: Read, Grep, Glob, or a Bash command that names catalog.json or only shows text (ADR-0012 Decision 2, Quiet results). Journal results are never quiet.

skipped.description: Lines the extractor did not use. json: lines that are not a JSON object. type: per record type it does not read, how many lines had it (api-request-blob, which repeats content, is one). The extractor reads the types user, assistant and system in agent transcripts, and launched, started and result in journals.

line.description: 1-based line number of the record in that file.

quote.description: The first 200 characters of the text line the item rests on, trimmed. Stays inside .git.

agent.description: The record's agentId, or main for the main session's own transcript.

oneOf.description: toolError: a tool_result block with is_error true that is no refusal.

tool.description: The name of the tool_use the result answers, else null.

oneOf.description: refusal: a tool call refused before or as it ran. source is refusalOf's (hooks/register.ts) for a tool_result, with truss for truss's hooks; factory is a factory.ts command that exited 1 with a JSON body, the factory gate.

category.description: refusalOf's category; for factory, the command name, such as finish.

oneOf.description: repeat: a Bash command string run more than once in one transcript file. line is the first run's; lines lists every run's. retried is true when a run before the last one errored.

quote.description: The command's first line, first 200 characters.

oneOf.description: step: one Workflow agent, from its journal started line to the last timestamp in its own transcript. file and line are the journal's started line.

start.description: First timestamp in the agent's transcript, else null.

end.description: Last timestamp in the agent's transcript, else null.

ms.description: end minus start in milliseconds, else null.

oneOf.description: stop: a journal result whose result.marker or result.stop.tag is BLOCKED, CHECKPOINT or QUESTION (marker is that tag; quote is the first non-empty line of result.text, empty when it has none); else a journal result whose `text`, or else whose `report` (or the result itself, when it is a string), has a first non-empty line starting `BLOCKED:`, `CHECKPOINT:` or `QUESTION:` (retro/extract.ts:215, :223-229), or an agent's last assistant text that does. One item per result, at the journal line.
qcFail: a text block or journal result holding a line that is exactly VERDICT: FAIL.
handEdit: a Write, Edit or NotebookEdit tool_use in the main session's own transcript whose file_path is outside the truss dir: the PM editing by hand.
checkFail: an errored Bash tool_result whose text holds at least one trace path, <file>.<ts|js|mjs|cjs|py>:<line>. traces lists the distinct ones, at most 10, in the order they appear.
